name: frameport
description: View, inspect, screenshot and record local video sources (HDMI) inside VS Code.

scripts.test:ffmpeg-missing:docker: docker build -f docker/ffmpeg-missing/Dockerfile -t frameport-ffmpeg-missing . && docker run --rm frameport-ffmpeg-missing

frameport.ffmpegPath.description: Path to an existing FFmpeg executable. On Apple Silicon, commonly /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg.

frameport.previewFps.description: Maximum requested preview refresh rate. Lower values reduce preview work; source capture and recording are independent.

frameport.recordingEncoder.description: Recording encoder. Software (libx264) makes smaller files and works everywhere. Hardware (VideoToolbox on macOS) can lower CPU while recording but makes larger files; falls back with an actionable error when unavailable.

frameport.saveRoot.description: Root folder for autosaved captures. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is. With no workspace, captures go under ~/FramePort.

frameport.screenshotFolder.description: Subfolder under saveRoot for PNG screenshots.

frameport.videoFolder.description: Subfolder under saveRoot for MP4 recordings.

frameport.saveMode.description: auto writes screenshots and recordings into the configured folders without a dialog. ask shows the save dialog (still defaulting into those folders).

frameport.filenameStyle.description: timestamp uses frameport-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS. sequential uses frameport-0001, frameport-0002, …. Existing files are never overwritten.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: FramePort launches a local FFmpeg capture process.
